Hi Samantha / Tom,

Thanks again for taking the time today — really appreciate the thoughtful questions on compliance and logging. Quick recap and next steps from our end: 

- SOC 2: Redwood is currently SOC 2 Type II in progress; our most recent readiness assessment completed in Q4 2026. We can share the readiness summary and controls mapping.
- GDPR/HIPAA: We support data residency and customer-configurable retention, and provide BAA options.
- Audit logging capabilities (high level): admin activity logs (UI and API), API request/response logs, system events, and export hooks (S3 export, syslog, and streaming to SIEM). Logs include actor, timestamp, resource, action, request_id, and outcome.
- Immutability & retention: logs are tamper-evident within the platform; we offer configurable retention policies and export to your storage for long-term retention/WORM requirements.

Attached is a short audit-logging overview (redwood-audit-logging-overview.pdf) that covers fields, retention, and export options. I also started a vendor questionnaire based on the spreadsheet you sent — link below.

Ask for Acme: can you confirm the specific evidence you need from the SOC 2 report (e.g., full report, controls matrix, or specific test evidence)? Also please confirm any minimum retention window or WORM requirements for audit logs.

Next steps:
- I will attach the logging overview and the questionnaire template.
- Rishi (cc) will follow up on technical specifics (format/schema for exported logs, example events).
- Vivek (cc) will propose a follow-up slot next week to walk through the questionnaire and sample logs.

Thanks — talk soon.

Best,

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the quick recap and the overview — that helps a lot. A few clarifying questions from the security team: 

1) SOC 2: we need to know the target date for final Type II report and whether Redwood is willing to provide a SOC 2 bridge letter or interim evidence in the meantime.
2) For logs: do exported logs include full request/response payloads by default, or is that redacted? We need at least request metadata (headers, user id, request_id) and the ability to export payloads for our internal investigations (subject to PII minimization).
3) Immutability: does Redwood support WORM or do you rely on customer-side WORM after S3 export?
4) Questionnaire: we prefer the completed spreadsheet and sample logs in CSV/ndjson.

We can share the Acme vendor security questionnaire — attaching our standard spreadsheet (acme-security-questionnaire.xlsx).

Can Rishi provide a short example (one hour) of a raw exported API log and the schema? If possible, please include a note about redaction options.

Thanks,
Samantha

Acme Corp

Hi Samantha / Tom — thanks for the questions, answers below (high level). Rishi, feel free to add technical details.

1) SOC 2: Final Type II report targeted for Q2 2027. We can provide a bridge letter and our controls matrix today. We also provide point-in-time evidence (controls mapping) for procurement teams.

2) Exported logs: By default exports include request metadata and non-sensitive payloads. Full request/response payload export is available as an option but can be configured to redact PII fields. We support exports in ndjson and CSV.

3) Immutability: Redwood supports tamper-evident internal storage and audit trails; for strict WORM requirements customers typically export to their own S3 bucket and apply WORM retention on their side. We can enact server-side immutability features for some enterprise Private deployments — happy to discuss specifics in the next call.

4) Questionnaire & samples: attached is our completed questionnaire template and a sample ndjson export of API logs (sample_api_logs.ndjson). The attached PDF covers field descriptions and retention.

Rishi: can you confirm the schema fields included in the ndjson (timestamp, actor_id, action, resource_type, resource_id, request_id, status, ip, user_agent, raw_payload) and whether we can supply a small redacted payload example?

Action items:
- Marissa: share completed questionnaire + logging overview (attached).
- Rishi: upload redacted sample logs to shared Drive.
- Vivek: coordinate follow-up meeting (proposal below).

Best,
Marissa
